environment.name: IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL
environment.label: API base URL
environment.description: Complete OpenAI-compatible API base, including /v1 when required. Needs model discovery and the selected Images, Responses, or Files/Batches endpoints; provider capabilities vary.

zh-CN.label: 模型服务基础地址
zh-CN.description: 完整的 OpenAI 兼容 API 基础地址，按供应商要求包含 /v1；须支持模型列表和所选 Images、Responses 或 Files/Batches 接口，具体能力以供应商为准。

environment.name: IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_API_KEY
environment.label: API key
environment.description: Required for live provider requests: model discovery, generation, editing, Responses, file uploads, and batch operations. Not needed for local dry runs or saving a stored response.

zh-CN.label: API 密钥
zh-CN.description: 在线请求供应商时必需，包括模型发现、图像生成与编辑、Responses、文件上传和批量操作；本地 dry-run 及保存已有响应无需密钥。
